fusions.name: Silk-Strung Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Trap-Line Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Snare Anchor
fusions.desc: Sets a web trap for 60 seconds. When an enemy comes within 3 tiles, it bursts and deals 10 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Web-Spinner
fusions.desc: A Webspinner fights beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 3 damage and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
